sentences.text: Lipstick Waale Sapne -LRB- English : Lipstick Under My Burkha -RRB- is an Indian film made in Hindi .	Hindi	Hindi language
The film is directed by Alankrita Shrivastava and produced by Prakash Jha .	Prakash Jha	Prakash Jha

The film stars Konkona Sen Sharma , Ratna Pathak , Aahana Kumra and Plabita Borthakur in lead roles along with Sushant Singh , Vikrant Massey , Shashank Arora , Vaibhav Tatwawaadi and Jagat Singh Solanki .	Konkona Sen Sharma	Konkona Sen Sharma	Ratna Pathak	Ratna Pathak	Aahana Kumra	Aahana Kumra	Sushant Singh	Sushant Singh	Vaibhav Tatwawaadi	Vaibhav Tatwawaadi	Vikrant Massey	Vikrant Massey	Shashank Arora	Shashank Arora
The trailer of film was released on 14 October 2016 .
The film premiered at the Tokyo and Mumbai Film Festivals , where it won the Spirit of Asia Prize and the Oxfam Award for Best Film on Gender Equality .	Tokyo	Tokyo Film Festival

In January 2017 , the Central Board of Film Certification refused to certify the film , stating that `` The story is lady oriented , their fantasy above life .	Central Board of Film Certification	Central Board of Film Certification
